CHAITRA K ServiceNow Developer Email: chaitrak998@gmail.com Phone: +91 9353226321 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/chaitra-k-02ab851b3/

Professional Objective

Results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, CMDB and GRC/IRM modules. Skilled in workflow automation, platform customization, REST API integrations, and enterprise application development, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Committed to enhancing service delivery, optimizing business processes, improving user experience, and driving operational excellence while contributing to organizational growth and digital transformation initiatives.

Professional Summary

Dynamic and results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CMDB, and GRC/IRM modules.

Extensive experience implementing and enhancing core ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, Service Catalog, and Service Portal, while developing complex Catalog Items, Record Producers, reusable workflows, and automated fulfillment processes.

Strong expertise in ServiceNow platform development using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, Glide API, and server-side scripting, following ServiceNow best practices to deliver upgrade-safe and maintainable solutions.  Hands-on experience implementing and customizing HR Service Delivery (HRSD) solutions, including HR Case Management, Employee Service Center, HR Knowledge Base, Lifecycle Events, Employee Document Management, and Employee Service Requests, improving employee experience through streamlined HR processes.

Experienced in configuring and enhancing GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue Management, Risk Assessments, Vendor Risk Management, and Audit Management, helping organizations strengthen governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk visibility.

Proficient in designing risk assessment questionnaires, risk scoring models, control testing workflows, compliance indicators, issue remediation plans, and automated approval workflows to support enterprise governance and risk management initiatives.  Good understanding of CMDB, Discovery, CI class modeling, relationship mapping, and dependency management to improve service visibility and operational stability across enterprise environments.

Hands-on experience integrating ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and third-party services, implementing payload transformations, OAuth 2.0/Bearer token authentication, and event-driven integrations.

Experienced in developing automation using Flow Designer, Workflows, Flow Logic, Subflows, Business Rules, Events, and Scheduled Jobs to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.

Skilled in application migration and release management using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, Application Repository, and version-controlled deployment practices across development, testing, and production environments.

Strong experience implementing platform security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), role-based access control (RBAC), data validation, and governance best practices to ensure secure and compliant application development.

Proficient in creating Performance Analytics dashboards, reports, workspace components, notifications, and executive-level reporting, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational visibility.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with proven ability to gather requirements, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver high-quality ServiceNow solutions aligned with ITIL best practices and modern ServiceNow architecture.

Technical Skills

Platform : ServiceNow Development

Modules: ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, CMDB, GRC/IRM,

Workflow & Automation: Service Catalog, Flow Designer, Workflows

Scripting & Customization: Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI

Policies, UI Actions, ACLs

Programming: JavaScript, GlideRecord, Glide API

Integrations: REST API Integrations, Scripted REST APIs

Employment Details

ServiceNow Developer (Rehired) | Axisweb Technologies Pvt Ltd | May 2022 – Present

Technical Support Engineer | Maintec Technologies Pvt Ltd | Jan 2022 – Apr 2022

Technical Analyst | Axisweb Technologies Pvt Ltd | June 2021 – Dec 2021

Projects and Responsibilities

Project #1:

Role: ServiceNow Developer

Responsibilities:

Developed and enhanced ServiceNow GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue Management, Risk Assessments, and Audit Management, to support enterprise governance and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Configured risk statements, risk assessment methodologies, risk scoring models, risk indicators (KRIs), control objectives, control tests, and issue remediation workflows to improve enterprise risk visibility and compliance monitoring.

Designed and customized policy lifecycle workflows, policy attestations, compliance tasks, and automated approval processes to streamline governance activities and ensure adherence to organizational standards. Implemented automated risk assessment questionnaires, risk calculation logic, and approval workflows using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and UI Policies.



Customized GRC/IRM workspaces, dashboards, reports, and Performance Analytics to provide real-time visibility into organizational risks, compliance status, control effectiveness, and remediation progress.

Developed secure platform functionality using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, and Glide API, following ServiceNow best practices and upgrade-safe development standards.  Configured users, groups, roles, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) to enforce role- based security and ensure appropriate access to sensitive governance and compliance data. Integrated ServiceNow GRC/IRM with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, OAuth 2.0, and Basic Authentication, enabling seamless exchange of compliance and risk-related information. Implemented and enhanced HRSD Risk and Compliance processes by automating HR case evaluations, employee risk assessments, and governance workflows to improve regulatory compliance.





Built advanced Service Catalog Items and Record Producers with dynamic variables, approvals, SLAs, and automated fulfillment processes to support governance and operational requests.

Customized Agent Workspace and CSM Workspace components to improve agent productivity through configurable layouts, workspaces, and guided processes.

Managed data migration activities using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, Scheduled Imports, Update Sets, and Scoped Applications, ensuring reliable deployments across multiple environments.

Contributed to CMDB health improvements through CI data quality validation, relationship mapping, Discovery support, and dependency management to enhance operational visibility.

Enhanced user experience by customizing Service Portal, developing reusable widgets, and implementing intuitive self-service interfaces for governance and compliance processes.

Performed root cause analysis, debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning to resolve production issues, improve platform stability, and ensure high-quality, upgrade- safe implementations.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, compliance teams, risk managers, and cross- functional development teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver enterprise applications aligned with ITIL and organizational governance standards.

Project #2:

Role: ServiceNow Developer

Responsibilities:

Developed and customized ServiceNow ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog, to automate business processes and improve service delivery. Implemented business requirements using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, and Background Scripts, ensuring scalable and upgrade-safe solutions.



Designed and developed Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variable Sets, catalog client scripts, and approval workflows to streamline request fulfillment.

Customized forms, views, related lists, reference qualifiers, and client-side components to enhance usability and improve the overall user experience.

Developed automation using Flow Designer, including flows, subflows, approvals, notifications, and event-driven actions to eliminate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.

Created reusable server-side logic and custom scripts to automate assignment, SLA



management, notifications, task creation, and business process orchestration. Integrated ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payload processing, and OAuth/Basic Authentication for secure data exchange.

Developed and customized Service Portal components, including widgets, client scripts, catalog pages, and UI enhancements to improve the self-service experience.

Built interactive reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics indicators to provide insights into incident trends, SLA compliance, service performance, and operational KPIs.

Developed data import solutions using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, and Scheduled Imports to automate data migration while maintaining data integrity.  Contributed to CMDB enhancements by developing scripts for CI updates, relationship



management, and data validation to improve configuration data quality. Implemented role-based security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), user criteria, and role configurations to protect sensitive business data and enforce organizational security policies.

Participated in application deployments using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, and version-controlled development practices, ensuring smooth migration across development, testing, and production environments.

Performed troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis using System Logs, Background Scripts, JavaScript Debugger, and Script Tracer, resolving production issues and improving platform performance.

Collaborated with business analysts, solution architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements, develop technical solutions, perform unit testing, and deliver high- quality enhancements aligned with ITIL best practices and ServiceNow development standards.

Project #3:

Role: ServiceNow Developer

Responsibilities:

Delivered a comprehensive ServiceNow implementation integrating HR Service Delivery (HRSD), ITSM, and Customer Service Management (CSM) for a global enterprise client, streamlining employee lifecycle processes and customer support operations.

Configured HR Case Management, Knowledge Base, and Employee Service Center portals, improving onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and access request efficiency  Automated ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management, integrating with HRSD to ensure seamless ticket handoffs and faster resolution.

Designed CSM workflows to manage customer inquiries, escalations, and SLA tracking, providing real-time visibility and unified reporting dashboards.

Developed custom workflows and Flow Designer flows for HR and IT request fullfilment, reducing manual intervention by 35% and improving employee and customer satisfaction.

Configured email notifications, inbound actions, and service catalog items to automate request capture, Implemented CMDB alignment and CI relationships to maintain accurate asset and HR data for compliance and audit purposes.

Built interactive dashboards and Performance Analytics reports, enabling executives to track SLA compliance, ticket trends, and service health across HR, IT, and Customer Service channels.

Administered roles, ACLs, and SSO and LDAP integration for secure access management, Leveraged JavaScript, Glide API, HTML5, CSS3, and AngularJS for portal customization and responsive UI design.

Followed Agile/Scrum methodology using JIRA for sprint planning, backlog management, and iterative delivery, while conducting peer mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge transfer sessions to strengthen team capabilities.

Educational Qualification

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E) — HMS institute of Technology, VTU University, Tumkur. 2015-2019

Projects and Responsibilities
Project #1:
Role: ServiceNow Developer
Responsibilities:
Developed and enhanced ServiceNow GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue Management, Risk Assessments, and Audit Management, to support enterprise governance and regulatory compliance initiatives.
Configured risk statements, risk assessment methodologies, risk scoring models, risk indicators (KRIs), control objectives, control tests, and issue remediation workflows to improve enterprise risk visibility and compliance monitoring.
Designed and customized policy lifecycle workflows, policy attestations, compliance tasks, and automated approval processes to streamline governance activities and ensure adherence to organizational standards. Implemented automated risk assessment questionnaires, risk calculation logic, and approval workflows using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and UI Policies.

Customized GRC/IRM workspaces, dashboards, reports, and Performance Analytics to provide real-time visibility into organizational risks, compliance status, control effectiveness, and remediation progress.
Developed secure platform functionality using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, and Glide API, following ServiceNow best practices and upgrade-safe development standards.  Configured users, groups, roles, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) to enforce role- based security and ensure appropriate access to sensitive governance and compliance data. Integrated ServiceNow GRC/IRM with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, OAuth 2.0, and Basic Authentication, enabling seamless exchange of compliance and risk-related information. Implemented and enhanced HRSD Risk and Compliance processes by automating HR case evaluations, employee risk assessments, and governance workflows to improve regulatory compliance.


Built advanced Service Catalog Items and Record Producers with dynamic variables, approvals, SLAs, and automated fulfillment processes to support governance and operational requests.
Customized Agent Workspace and CSM Workspace components to improve agent productivity through configurable layouts, workspaces, and guided processes.
Managed data migration activities using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, Scheduled Imports, Update Sets, and Scoped Applications, ensuring reliable deployments across multiple environments.
Contributed to CMDB health improvements through CI data quality validation, relationship mapping, Discovery support, and dependency management to enhance operational visibility.
Enhanced user experience by customizing Service Portal, developing reusable widgets, and implementing intuitive self-service interfaces for governance and compliance processes.
Performed root cause analysis, debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning to resolve production issues, improve platform stability, and ensure high-quality, upgrade- safe implementations.
Collaborated with business stakeholders, compliance teams, risk managers, and cross- functional development teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver enterprise applications aligned with ITIL and organizational governance standards.
Project #2:
Role: ServiceNow Developer
Responsibilities:
Developed and customized ServiceNow ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog, to automate business processes and improve service delivery. Implemented business requirements using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, and Background Scripts, ensuring scalable and upgrade-safe solutions.

Designed and developed Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variable Sets, catalog client scripts, and approval workflows to streamline request fulfillment.
Customized forms, views, related lists, reference qualifiers, and client-side components to enhance usability and improve the overall user experience.
Developed automation using Flow Designer, including flows, subflows, approvals, notifications, and event-driven actions to eliminate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
Created reusable server-side logic and custom scripts to automate assignment, SLA

management, notifications, task creation, and business process orchestration. Integrated ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, JSON and XML payload processing, and OAuth/Basic Authentication for secure data exchange.
Developed and customized Service Portal components, including widgets, client scripts, catalog pages, and UI enhancements to improve the self-service experience.
Built interactive reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics indicators to provide insights into incident trends, SLA compliance, service performance, and operational KPIs.
Developed data import solutions using Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources, and Scheduled Imports to automate data migration while maintaining data integrity.  Contributed to CMDB enhancements by developing scripts for CI updates, relationship

management, and data validation to improve configuration data quality. Implemented role-based security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), user criteria, and role configurations to protect sensitive business data and enforce organizational security policies.
Participated in application deployments using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, and version-controlled development practices, ensuring smooth migration across development, testing, and production environments.
Performed troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis using System Logs, Background Scripts, JavaScript Debugger, and Script Tracer, resolving production issues and improving platform performance.
Collaborated with business analysts, solution architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements, develop technical solutions, perform unit testing, and deliver high- quality enhancements aligned with ITIL best practices and ServiceNow development standards.
Project #3:
Role: ServiceNow Developer
Responsibilities:
Delivered a comprehensive ServiceNow implementation integrating HR Service Delivery (HRSD), ITSM, and Customer Service Management (CSM) for a global enterprise client, streamlining employee lifecycle processes and customer support operations.
Configured HR Case Management, Knowledge Base, and Employee Service Center portals, improving onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and access request efficiency  Automated ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management, integrating with HRSD to ensure seamless ticket handoffs and faster resolution.
Designed CSM workflows to manage customer inquiries, escalations, and SLA tracking, providing real-time visibility and unified reporting dashboards.
Developed custom workflows and Flow Designer flows for HR and IT request fullfilment, reducing manual intervention by 35% and improving employee and customer satisfaction.
Configured email notifications, inbound actions, and service catalog items to automate request capture, Implemented CMDB alignment and CI relationships to maintain accurate asset and HR data for compliance and audit purposes.
Built interactive dashboards and Performance Analytics reports, enabling executives to track SLA compliance, ticket trends, and service health across HR, IT, and Customer Service channels.
Administered roles, ACLs, and SSO and LDAP integration for secure access management, Leveraged JavaScript, Glide API, HTML5, CSS3, and AngularJS for portal customization and responsive UI design.
Followed Agile/Scrum methodology using JIRA for sprint planning, backlog management, and iterative delivery, while conducting peer mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge transfer sessions to strengthen team capabilities.

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E) — HMS institute of Technology, VTU University, Tumkur. 2015-2019

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Professional Objective
Results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, CMDB and GRC/IRM modules. Skilled in workflow automation, platform customization, REST API integrations, and enterprise application development, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Committed to enhancing service delivery, optimizing business processes, improving user experience, and driving operational excellence while contributing to organizational growth and digital transformation initiatives.
Professional Summary
Dynamic and results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CMDB, and GRC/IRM modules.
Extensive experience implementing and enhancing core ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, Service Catalog, and Service Portal, while developing complex Catalog Items, Record Producers, reusable workflows, and automated fulfillment processes.
Strong expertise in ServiceNow platform development using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Data Policies, Scheduled Jobs, Background Scripts, Glide API, and server-side scripting, following ServiceNow best practices to deliver upgrade-safe and maintainable solutions.  Hands-on experience implementing and customizing HR Service Delivery (HRSD) solutions, including HR Case Management, Employee Service Center, HR Knowledge Base, Lifecycle Events, Employee Document Management, and Employee Service Requests, improving employee experience through streamlined HR processes.
Experienced in configuring and enhancing GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue Management, Risk Assessments, Vendor Risk Management, and Audit Management, helping organizations strengthen governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk visibility.
Proficient in designing risk assessment questionnaires, risk scoring models, control testing workflows, compliance indicators, issue remediation plans, and automated approval workflows to support enterprise governance and risk management initiatives.  Good understanding of CMDB, Discovery, CI class modeling, relationship mapping, and dependency management to improve service visibility and operational stability across enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience integrating ServiceNow with external applications using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and third-party services, implementing payload transformations, OAuth 2.0/Bearer token authentication, and event-driven integrations.
Experienced in developing automation using Flow Designer, Workflows, Flow Logic, Subflows, Business Rules, Events, and Scheduled Jobs to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
Skilled in application migration and release management using Update Sets, Scoped Applications, Application Repository, and version-controlled deployment practices across development, testing, and production environments.
Strong experience implementing platform security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), role-based access control (RBAC), data validation, and governance best practices to ensure secure and compliant application development.
Proficient in creating Performance Analytics dashboards, reports, workspace components, notifications, and executive-level reporting, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational visibility.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with proven ability to gather requirements, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver high-quality ServiceNow solutions aligned with ITIL best practices and modern ServiceNow architecture.

Responsibilities:

Configured HR Case Management, Knowledge Base, and Employee Service Center portals, improving onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and access request efficiency  Automated ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management, integrating with HRSD to ensure seamless ticket handoffs and faster resolution.
Designed CSM workflows to manage customer inquiries, escalations, and SLA tracking, providing real-time visibility and unified reporting dashboards.
Developed custom workflows and Flow Designer flows for HR and IT request fullfilment, reducing manual intervention by 35% and improving employee and customer satisfaction.
Configured email notifications, inbound actions, and service catalog items to automate request capture, Implemented CMDB alignment and CI relationships to maintain accurate asset and HR data for compliance and audit purposes.
Built interactive dashboards and Performance Analytics reports, enabling executives to track SLA compliance, ticket trends, and service health across HR, IT, and Customer Service channels.
Administered roles, ACLs, and SSO and LDAP integration for secure access management, Leveraged JavaScript, Glide API, HTML5, CSS3, and AngularJS for portal customization and responsive UI design.
